File: tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py
Line or code reference: lines 385-466 (three new test functions defined) and lines 682-701 (main() function)
Problem: The three new regression tests defined in this PR —
`test_auto_merge_guard_suppresses_forward_merge_fallback_pr_on_codex_agent_path` (line 385),
`test_auto_merge_guard_suppresses_forward_merge_fallback_pr_on_deterministic_skip_path` (line 421),
and `test_gate_emits_head_ref_output_for_forward_merge_suppressor_reuse` (line 448) —
are never called from `main()`.
Why it fails at runtime: Running `python3 tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py` silently skips all three new tests. The PR description's test plan claim "17 passed, 0 failed (4 new + 13 existing, no regressions)" is false — only 13 tests actually execute, and all three new tests are dead code incapable of catching regressions. A future edit that removes the forward-merge suppressor from either path or breaks the `head_ref` output propagation will not be detected.
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

File: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml
Line or code reference: lines 720-726 (deterministic-skip-merge workflow summary block)
Problem: The workflow run summary unconditionally reports `- **Auto-merge:** ENABLED (squash)` whenever `ENABLE_AUTO_MERGE=true`, using only the variable value as the condition. It does not account for the new forward-merge suppressor at lines 696-708 that short-circuits before the `gh pr merge --squash --auto` call.
Why it fails at runtime: When a forward-merge fallback PR qualifies for the deterministic-skip path (small diff or doc-only), the suppressor correctly fires and skips the squash-auto call, but the summary still reports auto-merge as ENABLED. An operator inspecting the GitHub Actions run summary will see "ENABLED (squash)" and may incorrectly believe auto-merge was armed for a PR that must be manually merged via "Create a merge commit."
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
